summary: Distinguish prose study delivery from selected deterministic checker/structured receipt input contracts.
revisit: At a relevant handoff choice, identify whether prose delivery, actual artifact reception or a selected checker/receipt format is needed. No blanket historical rewrite.
acceptance: Existing study records can carry ordinary report delivery; actual artifact reception and selected tools retain their required checks and strict inputs.
design_basis: Existing public separation of study use and maintenance/tool inputs. A bounded private route observation motivates clarification, not a universal efficiency claim.
